expectations.text: Replaces the month-1 onboarding list with a shipped friction log as the day-30 deliverable
expectations.evidence: "**Deliverable:** a friction log covering every confusing point from signup through first alert — each entry severity-rated with a proposed fix, handed to product/eng, not filed and forgotten."

expectations.text: Specifies that the friction log carries a severity and a proposed fix for each point
expectations.evidence: "each entry severity-rated with a proposed fix"

expectations.text: Sets a day-60 milestone of one shipped artefact in the target pillar, paired with an existing team member
expectations.evidence: "Ship one artefact in the enablement pillar ... paired with an existing eng or docs owner, not solo."

expectations.text: Requires at least one friction-log fix from day 30 to land by day 60, driven through docs or engineering by the new hire
expectations.evidence: "Land at least one fix from the day-30 friction log end-to-end: drive it through eng/docs review into production, not just log it."

expectations.text: Requires a first attempt at the metric the role's funding driver is measured on by day 60, even as a rough baseline number
expectations.evidence: "Produce a rough baseline number for the activation metric above — doesn't need to be polished, needs to exist."

expectations.text: Sets a day-90 milestone of self-directed ownership of one recurring program slice, without a pairing partner
expectations.evidence: "Own one recurring, explicitly scoped program slice without a pairing partner — e.g., the developer-facing changelog cadence, a monthly office-hours session, or the doc-fix pipeline"

expectations.text: Requires a written plan by day 90 for the funding-driver metric, covering what good looks like in two quarters and how it will be tracked
expectations.evidence: "Deliver a written plan for the activation metric: target for two quarters out, and how it'll be tracked (dashboard, cadence, owner)."

expectations.text: Requires a joint, written manager and new-hire decision at day 90 on continuing at the current scope, adjusting it, or escalating a concern
expectations.evidence: "Manager and hire jointly sign off in writing at day 90: continue at current scope, adjust it, or escalate a concern."

expectations.text: Treats the three missed milestones as an explicit decision trigger rather than an assumed extended grace period
expectations.evidence: "If the day-30 friction log, the day-60 artefact, or the day-90 metric baseline hasn't shipped on schedule, that's a scheduled conversation, not an unstated grace period."

expectations.text: Replaces 'attend a conference' with a shipped deliverable, since attendance is an activity and not a milestone
